newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian court jails man who traded human flesh.
newsitem.headline: Russian court jails man who traded human flesh.

text.p: A Russian court sentenced a murderer who traded pieces of his victim's flesh as ordinary meat to eight years in prison on Saturday, Itar-Tass news agency said.
The man, Anatoly Dolbyshev, from the town of Berezniki in the Urals region of Perm, was found guilty of stabbing to death a friend of his mother's in a fight.
Dolbyshev, who had several previous convictions, then cut up his victim's body and sold pieces of the human flesh to unsuspecting local townsfolk in exchange for vodka.
Police were called when one buyer found a strip of human skin in the meat, the agency said.
The court found Dolbyshev guilty of murder, "swindling and appropriation of property through deceit", Tass said, adding that the Russian Criminal Code did not contain a more appropriate article.
